mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN') AS open_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS open_principal, COALESCE(SUM(t.accrued_interest) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS open_accrued, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.maturity_date <= #{today} + 7) AS due_in_7_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATURED') AS matured_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'CLOSED_EARLY') AS closed_early_count FROM term_deposits t

SELECT p.code AS code, p.tenor_months AS tenor_months, p.rate_bps AS rate_bps, COUNT(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN') AS open_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS open_principal, COALESCE(SUM(t.accrued_interest) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS open_accrued FROM deposit_products p LEFT JOIN term_deposits t ON t.product_code = p.code GROUP BY p.code, p.tenor_months, p.rate_bps ORDER BY p.tenor_months
